question: On 31st January 2022, who was appointed as Director General of the National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Madan Mohan Tripathi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **31st January 2022**, **Dr. Madan Mohan Tripathi** was appointed as the **Director General of the National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT**
 
• He has a strong background in electronics and information technology, which aligns with NIELIT’s mission to promote the development and application of IT and electronics across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. Narayan Pradhan** – Dr. Narayan Pradhan is a well-known researcher in materials science and nanotechnology, particularly associated with the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science (IACS). 
 
• **Dr. Amrita Hazra** – Dr. Amrita Hazra is recognized for her work in microbiology and biosciences. Her research focuses on enzyme mechanisms and antibiotic resistance. 
 
• **Dr. Pinaki Talukdar** – Dr. Pinaki Talukdar is a scientist known for his work in the field of chemical sciences, specifically organic and medicinal chemistry.
